rooms.name: Sector #bm_sector# Office Wing
rooms.description: #bm_office_desc#

rooms.name: #bm_department# Offices
rooms.description: Cubicles in grey fabric run in rows, chairs overturned, monitors still glowing. #bm_office_detail.cap#.

rooms.name: Break Room #bm_num#
rooms.description: A small staff kitchen: a fridge, a microwave, a coffee machine with a burnt pot, a notice about washing your own mug.

rooms.name: Conference Room #bm_num#
rooms.description: A long table, a projector screen showing a frozen slide of quarterly results, and coffee cups abandoned mid-meeting.

rooms.name: #bm_lab_kind# Lab #bm_sector#-#bm_num#
rooms.description: #bm_lab_desc#

rooms.name: Specimen Storage
rooms.description: Glass tanks line the walls, some cracked and drained. Labels read XEN SAMPLE, DO NOT AGITATE.

rooms.name: Decontamination Bay #bm_num#
rooms.description: Shower nozzles in a white-tiled booth, a radiation sign and a warning klaxon that has long since given up.

rooms.name: Isotope Handling Room
rooms.description: Lead-lined cabinets, remote manipulator arms and a glowing green puddle you decide not to step in.

rooms.name: Maintenance Corridor #bm_sector#-#bm_num#
rooms.description: #bm_maint_desc#

rooms.name: Pump Station #bm_num#
rooms.description: Big green pumps thump in a concrete room ankle-deep in water. Pipes sweat overhead.

rooms.name: Ventilation Shaft
rooms.description: A cramped sheet-metal duct. You crawl on your elbows; the fan somewhere ahead goes round and round.

rooms.name: Electrical Substation
rooms.description: Transformers hum behind chain-link. A sign warns DANGER: HIGH VOLTAGE in three languages.

rooms.name: Boiler Room
rooms.description: Huge boilers roar, gauges trembling in the red. The heat is like a wall.

rooms.name: Tram Platform #bm_sector#
rooms.description: A tram platform with yellow safety lines and a dead departures board. The rails vanish into the dark either way.

rooms.name: Service Tunnel #bm_num#
rooms.description: A long rail service tunnel lit by caged bulbs. A maintenance cart sits abandoned on a siding.

rooms.name: Freight Elevator Shaft
rooms.description: A freight elevator stands open, its cage door bent. Cables vanish up into the dark.

rooms.name: Warehouse #bm_sector#
rooms.description: Shelving stacked to the roof with crates, a forklift parked askew. Somewhere a pallet creaks.

rooms.name: Loading Dock
rooms.description: Roller doors, yellow bollards and a ramp down to a truck bay. Everything smells of diesel.

rooms.name: Hazardous Materials Store
rooms.description: Yellow drums marked with radiation trefoils sit in a chain-link cage. Some are leaking.

rooms.name: #surface_name#
rooms.description: #surface_desc#

rooms.name: Abandoned Checkpoint
rooms.description: A sandbagged checkpoint on a dusty access road, the barrier arm snapped. A burnt-out humvee smoulders.

rooms.name: Satellite Dish Array
rooms.description: Huge white dishes stare at the sky on a scrubby ridge, some tilted at mad angles.

rooms.name: HECU #camp_kind#
rooms.description: #camp_desc#

rooms.name: Sandbag Emplacement
rooms.description: A ring of sandbags around a mounted machine gun, the gunner gone. Brass casings carpet the ground.

rooms.name: #xen_name#
rooms.description: #xen_desc#

rooms.name: Xen Healing Grotto
rooms.description: A cave of soft violet rock around a pool of luminous water.

rooms.name: Spore Field
rooms.description: Pod-plants the size of houses pulse slowly, releasing drifting motes of light.

rooms.name: Race X Hive
rooms.description: #racex_desc#

rooms.name: Infested Corridor
rooms.description: A Black Mesa corridor half-swallowed by Race X growth: ribbed, wet, faintly glowing, and humming like a struck wire.

feature.name: locked security door

appearance.text: A security door stands open, its lock smashed.
A heavy security door is locked here, its keycard reader blinking red.

feature.description: Standard Black Mesa blast-rated door. The reader wants a keycard, but the frame looks prisable.

bm_locked_door.open_text: You force the lock with {key}. The door grinds open.
bm_locked_door.locked_text: It's locked. A keycard, or something to lever it with, would do it.
bm_locked_door.blocked: A locked security door bars the way.

feature.name: jammed hatch

appearance.text: A maintenance hatch hangs open on bent hinges.
A maintenance hatch is jammed in its frame.

feature.description: Warped by heat or impact. It needs persuading.

bm_jammed_hatch.open_text: You wrench the hatch open with {key}.
bm_jammed_hatch.locked_text: It's jammed solid. You need a crowbar or something like it.
bm_jammed_hatch.blocked: A jammed hatch blocks the way.

feature.name: welded door

appearance.text: A door has been cut open; its edges still glow.
A steel door has been welded shut, the bead still shiny.

feature.description: Someone sealed this from the other side. Only a cutting torch is getting through.

of_welded_door.open_text: You cut a doorway with {key}. The panel falls inward with a clang.
of_welded_door.locked_text: Welded shut. A combat engineer's torch could cut it.
of_welded_door.blocked: A welded door blocks the way.

feature.name: supply locker

appearance.text: A steel supply locker is padlocked here.

feature.description: A steel locker with a cheap padlock and a security stencil.

bm_supply_locker.open_text: You snap the padlock with {key}. The locker swings open.

feature.name: chasm

appearance.text: You've marked a way across the chasm.
A gulf of empty violet sky separates this island from the next.

feature.description: Far too wide to jump. Unaided.

xen_chasm.open_text: You use {key} to cross the gap, and land rolling on the far side.
xen_chasm.locked_text: It's far too wide to jump without help.
xen_chasm.blocked: The chasm is too wide to cross.
